note: What the carbon programme needs us to evidence, and whether we are evidencing it. ONE ROW PER PARAMETER - a new requirement is a row here, not a redesign of the section. Coverage and freshness are NOT stored: tools/render_carbon_params.py derives coverage from the named population and freshness from data/extract_manifest.json every build. Only the declarative fields live here.
scope: This report answers one question about the carbon programme: can we supply the data it needs, and if not, what is missing and who owns it. Methodology interpretation, the design review and the Gold Standard relationship are the Head of Carbon's remit and are not tracked here.
source: Reconstructed 2026-09-23 from docs/methodology_version_map.md, docs/sdws27_basis.md and the live mWater form snapshot. NOT yet checked against claude/sdws-parameter-map-what-must-be-evidenced.md, which is in the Claude Project and is not readable from the build machine. Treat the row SET as provisional until someone reconciles it against that map; every row's evidence is derived and is not provisional.

parameters.name: People served by each water point
parameters.measure: How many people live close enough to use each pump, counted the same way every time.
parameters.source_label: WorldPop R2025A allocation over the mWater register
parameters.freshness_note: the WorldPop R2025A run of 16 Sep 2026, over the register as pulled by this build

parameters.name: Rehabilitation eligibility
parameters.measure: Evidence that the pump was out of action for at least three months before we rehabilitated it, and that nobody was maintaining it.

parameters.name: Water quality at the pump
parameters.measure: A passing microbial test for each point, so the water counts as safe.
parameters.source_label: Clean Water || Water Quality Testing SDWS 3 Result

parameters.name: Days the pump was working
parameters.measure: The gardien's paper calendar, marking the days the pump was NOT working, photographed during a maintenance visit.
parameters.gap: Fewer than half the carbon points have a readable dated 2026 sheet. The rest rest on the registered 347-day estimate with nothing on file behind it.

parameters.name: Water actually drawn
parameters.measure: Litres dispensed per pump, from the stroke counter on the handle.
parameters.source_label: Clean Water || Installation, Calibrage et relevé du compteur
parameters.gap: No population reads this form, so coverage cannot be derived. The form is also not pulled by the build, so its freshness is unknown.

parameters.name: People per household
parameters.measure: How many people usually live in each household surveyed.
parameters.source_label: Clean Water || Project Cbn&Gender (annual monitoring survey), WS1.12
parameters.gap: No population reads the survey, and the form is not pulled by the build.
parameters.commitment: VPA-DD B.7.1: same instrument as SDWS 26. Ex-ante values 4.5 Anosy and 3.7 Maroantsetra; the VPA-DD requires a cross-check against one external source in the Monitoring Report.

parameters.name: How often a household uses the pump
parameters.measure: Whether the household drew drinking water from this point at least every two days over the past year. Only premises reporting that may be counted as served.
parameters.source_label: Clean Water || Project Cbn&Gender (annual monitoring survey), WS1.18 and WS1.39
parameters.gap: Measured for the 2025 monitoring period from the round of 11-21 November 2025. It does not carry forward: 2026 needs its own round. Maroantsetra reached 6 clusters against the VPA-DD B.7.3 minimum of 8, and no response carries an approval.
parameters.commitment: VPA-DD B.7.1: source “SDWS 1; and Project survey”, annual, sampled, “Premises that report at least every two days use may be counted”. B.7.2: 90% confidence, 10% margin of error, CDM sample size calculator, minimum 100 households per project scenario, minimum 8 villages or communes as clusters per scenario, Anosy and Maroantsetra separate. B.7.3: face to face, on tablet, in mWater.

parameters.name: Water quality in the home
parameters.measure: A sample taken from the container the household actually drinks from, not from the pump.
parameters.gap: No population reads the survey, the form is not pulled by the build, and the boiling question the VPA-DD commits to is not on it — raised in the instrument review.
parameters.commitment: VPA-DD B.7.1: the same instrument yields SDWS 22, SDWS 25 and SDWS 26 and carries the WHO/UNICEF JMP core questions for drinking water and hygiene (SDWS 20).

parameters.name: New units built each year
parameters.measure: A count, per year and per type, of every rehabilitation and new borehole, so the one-off emissions of building them can be deducted in the right year.
parameters.source_label: Clean Water || Première réhabilitation, and the Marolinta borehole form
parameters.gap: New under v2.0. A per-year count by technology category is not maintained as a monitoring output, and it is charged in the year of commissioning, so it cannot be reconstructed later from a total.

parameters.name: Which other stove the household still uses
parameters.measure: An annual survey question on whether the household still uses its old stove or fire alongside ours, and how often.
parameters.gap: New under v2.0 and collected nowhere. If the question is not in the annual survey before renewal there is no time series, and a missing year cannot be filled in retrospectively.
parameters.freshness_note: nothing collected, so there is no record to be recent

parameters.name: Households told they cannot claim the carbon themselves
parameters.measure: A written statement in the Community Engagement Agreement that the community is not claiming emission reductions from the same water point.
parameters.gap: New under v2.0, must be verified before the first verification, and agreements already signed without the wording cannot be corrected retrospectively.
parameters.freshness_note: nothing collected, so there is no record to be recent

parameters.name: Minimum survey sample size
parameters.measure: At least 50 households per district in any sampled survey, not 30.
parameters.source_label: Sampling design, applies to every sampled parameter above
parameters.gap: Rounds drawn at 30 per stratum meet v1.0 and will not meet v2.0. Anything drawn after renewal needs 50.
parameters.freshness_note: a rule on how sampled parameters are drawn, not a record

parameters.name: Confidence intervals kept, not just averages
parameters.measure: For every sampled figure, keep the range around it as well as the number itself.
parameters.source_label: Sampling design, applies to every sampled parameter above
parameters.gap: A historic series of averages alone cannot show which branch of the conservatism rule applies at renewal.
parameters.freshness_note: a rule on how sampled parameters are drawn, not a record
